recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-25297 unless a future work-group decision intentionally changes the semantics of the token characteristic-value search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-25297 was Published/Persuasive and requested that the Group-characteristic-value composite search parameter's value component use only CodeableConcept or boolean values instead of all Group.characteristic.value[x] choices, because the referenced Group-value search parameter is token-typed.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 5ae61b9fd39cab957817b6bcb3333fdeaa98dcaa, which changed source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml from a plain value component expression to `(value as CodeableConcept) | (value as boolean)`. Later commits 7b140ecceeee41513b798b217e634fd50ce8ff8a and aac5d575d85079a62d82a54c7821a6d364e91672 converted equivalent FHIRPath casts to ofType() syntax.
additional_context: Group is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml current build input. The old Jira comment about XPath no longer identifies a current source inconsistency because SearchParameter XPath fields were removed in later source refactoring. FHIR-40341 later addressed quantity/range needs for Group search separately and already has a combined-branch reconciliation commit, so it does not alter the token-scoping decision for FHIR-25297.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/group/bundle-Group-search-params.xml has Group-characteristic-value component expression `(value.ofType(CodeableConcept)) | (value.ofType(boolean))`, and Group-value itself is scoped to `(Group.characteristic.value.ofType(CodeableConcept)) | (Group.characteristic.value.ofType(boolean))`.

related_jiras.note: Later Group search-parameter work addressed quantity/range needs separately and is already represented on the combined branch; it is background only for this seed.
